svg.text: DronePhotographer: action-conditioned score prediction from a single RGB view
Full pipeline: Blender rendering (v2/v3 with 3D metrics), GroundingDINO / mask-based detection, camera-local pair construction, Qwen-VL JSON generation, and MPC-based camera planning.
radius in [2, 8] m, hemisphere sampling, yaw/pitch/roll offsets
Renderer stores world pose vectors, not just Euler angles.
B. Add detections and derive score targets
control keys on the fly during dataset loading
score_annotations.py is optional materialization for inspection
For each source view i, choose nearby targets j:
Require detections only on target j; keep all sources i
Optional zero-action self-pairs are added with zero_action_ratio (default config: 0.1).
Inference keeps only the left branch: image_i + action_text -> predicted score JSON.
10 built-in presets: centered, thirds, portrait, cinematic, closeup...
batch VLM inference -> predicted score JSON
Offline: snap to nearest pre-rendered view
Real pair used for the figure: source i = 0, target j = 100, image size = 1024 x 768, camera-local action frame, orientation_6d.
The model receives the full RGB image only; there is no bbox token input.
image_j is not fed to the model; it only provides supervision.
camera-local action from i to j: move right 0.5570 m, up 1.1182 m, forward -0.3289 m,
then encode target forward/up vectors in image_i local basis (orientation_6d).
You are a drone image scorer.
Input is current image_i and an action command in camera-local frame of image_i
The action encodes the target camera orientation as target forward/up vectors.
Predict score values of image_j after applying the action.
orient_camera_local_6d(fx=..., fy=..., fz=..., ux=..., uy=..., uz=...)
The first character of your response must be '{' and the last character must be '}'.
Use keys exactly once and in this exact order: bbox_occupancy_ratio, ...
How the target JSON is computed from bbox_j
Given W = 1024, H = 768, bbox = (x1, y1, x2, y2)
The collator builds a user message plus assistant JSON, tokenizes both,
then masks prompt tokens with -100 so cross-entropy is applied only to
Important: the model never observes image_j.
It must infer future score_j from image_i plus the action command alone.
F. Current status: training data, v3 rendering, and known limitations

Mask-based ground-truth bbox + 3D metrics at render time.
